answer: A prism from a stranger, a terrace from a ledger, a saffron from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Honest work runs 31 minutes a proof; the farm needs 856 proofs, which is 26536 minutes it cannot paint. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 146376 POA while one agent pays 171. A mask is free until Tin smith zinc mark soldered into the painting shed names its price, and the price is written plainly as each zinc is a soldering record witnessed by the master tinsmith.
